name: Bulb Icon
description: Icon for tips, ideas, and helpful suggestions

variations.name: default
variations.description: Bulb fills and rays appear on hover to indicate ideas/tips

props.name: size
props.description: Width and height of the icon in pixels

props.name: color
props.description: Fill and stroke color of the icon (CSS color value)

props.name: isActive
props.description: Controls the light-up animation. Set to true to show filled bulb with rays.

props.name: duration
props.description: Duration of each ray/fill animation in seconds; ray stagger scales with it

props.name: ease
props.description: Easing of the animation. Accepts a named ease or a cubic-bezier array.
